message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerabilities were found that could be credibly matched to the components and versions in `DLL_software_component.txt` during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-25 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-26 07:40 UTC.

### Findings

No relevant findings met all three inclusion requirements: publication or material update within the window, credible sourcing, and a supported match to a listed DLL or software component.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services. The newest entries visible in the [official MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) were dated 2026-09-24, before this scan's cutoff, so no MongoDB-family advisory qualified.

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan window. Continue normal component-version monitoring; older advisories and general product-family reports were excluded unless a fresh, component-specific development occurred within the window.
